# Task: write `qwen_task.py`, long-term statistics of the tasks delegated to the local Qwen

Write ONE file, `qwen_task.py`, in the working directory. The acceptance tests are in
`tests/test_qwen_task.py`; do not modify them. Run them with `python -m pytest -q tests`.
Reference code (read only): `C:/Users/SIM/.claude/tools/qwen_savings.py`, the existing per-call logger. Use
the same style: module docstring explaining the purpose, the formulas and the usage; English; small functions;
standard library only, plus plotly imported lazily inside `write_html`.

## Context

Claude (the main assistant) delegates work to Qwen through `ask_local.py` / `qwen_agent.py`. Each Qwen call
appends one JSON line to `CALLS_FILE` (written by `qwen_savings.log_event`, not by you). A call line looks like:

```json
{"time": "2026-10-28T09:30:00", "tool": "qwen_agent", "project": "x", "saved_in": 1000, "saved_out": 2000,
 "qwen_in": 50000, "qwen_out": 8000, "minutes": 12.5, "note": "...", "task": "20261028-083000"}
```

`task` is present only when a task was open; older lines have no `task` key ("legacy calls").

A *task* groups the Qwen calls of one piece of work, plus what Claude itself spent during that work (writing the
prompt, reviewing, fixing). Claude's real token usage is read from the Claude Code transcript: a JSON-lines file
where each line is an object; the lines with `"type": "assistant"` have
`"timestamp": "2026-10-28T08:25:23.322Z"` (UTC, ISO 8601, trailing Z) and `"message": {"id": "...",
"usage": {...}}`. The usage dict has `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`,
`cache_creation_input_tokens` and, usually, `cache_creation: {"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens": a,
"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens": b}`. **One message is written on several lines with the same `message.id` and the
same usage: count each `message.id` once.** Lines of other types, or without usage, are ignored. Lines that are not
valid JSON are skipped.

## Paths (read at CALL time from the environment, never at import time, so tests can redirect them)

- `stats_dir()`: env `QWEN_STATS_DIR`, default `C:/Users/SIM/Desktop/Code-Adri/Qwen-Benchmark/stats`.
- `CALLS_FILE = stats_dir()/"qwen_usage.jsonl"`, `TASKS_FILE = stats_dir()/"tasks.jsonl"`,
  `CURRENT_FILE = stats_dir()/"current_task.json"`, `HTML_FILE = stats_dir()/"qwen_stats.html"`
  (implement as functions `calls_file()`, `tasks_file()`, `current_file()`, `html_file()`).
- `transcripts_dir()`: env `CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR`, default `~/.claude/projects`.

## Prices ($ per million tokens, Claude Opus 5.5 API)

```python
PRICES = {"input": 4.0, "output": 20.0, "cache_read": 0.4, "cache_write_5m": 5.0, "cache_write_1h": 8.0}
```

If a usage has `cache_creation_input_tokens` but no `cache_creation` dict, count those tokens as `cache_write_1h`.
Estimated savings of a call (same as qwen_savings): `(saved_in * 4.0 + saved_out * 20.0) / 1e6` dollars.

## Functions (exact names and signatures; the tests call them)

- `newest_transcript(root=None) -> Path | None`: newest (mtime) `*.jsonl` file in the subdirectories of
  `root` (default `transcripts_dir()`), pattern `root/*/*.jsonl`; None if there is none.
- `claude_usage(transcript, start, end) -> dict`: sums the usage of the assistant messages whose timestamp is in
  `[start, end]` (both `datetime`, timezone-aware UTC). Returns
  `{"turns": n_messages, "input": .., "output": .., "cache_read": .., "cache_write_5m": .., "cache_write_1h": ..,
  "tokens": sum of the five, "usd": cost with PRICES}`. `transcript=None` or a missing file -> all zeros.
- `current_task() -> dict | None`: content of `CURRENT_FILE`, or None.
- `start(title, at=None, transcript=None) -> dict`: opens a task. `at` = ISO string (with or without Z / offset;
  naive = UTC) or None = now (UTC). Raises `RuntimeError` if a task is already open. Writes `CURRENT_FILE` with
  `{"id": "YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS" of the start in UTC, "title": title, "start": ISO UTC string ending in "Z",
  "transcript": str(transcript or newest_transcript()) or None}` and returns that dict. Creates the stats dir.
- `end(outcome, note="", at=None) -> tuple[dict, str]`: closes the open task (`RuntimeError` if none). `outcome`
  must be one of `OUTCOMES = ("ok", "fixed", "failed", "abandoned")`, else `ValueError`:
  ok = Qwen's work used as is, fixed = used after Claude's corrections, failed = Claude redid it, abandoned.
  It collects the calls of `CALLS_FILE` whose `task` equals the id, measures `claude_usage` on the transcript
  recorded at start between start and `at` (default now), appends ONE short JSON line to `TASKS_FILE`, deletes
  `CURRENT_FILE`, and returns `(record, line)`. The record keys, in this order:
  `id, title, start, end, minutes` (wall clock, 1 decimal), `outcome, note` (note cut to 200 chars),
  `qwen_calls, qwen_minutes` (sum, 2 decimals), `qwen_tokens` (sum of qwen_in + qwen_out),
  `est_saved_tokens` (sum of saved_in + saved_out), `est_saved_usd` (4 decimals),
  `claude_turns, claude_tokens, claude_usd` (4 decimals), `claude_detail` (dict: input, output, cache_read,
  cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h), `net_usd = est_saved_usd - claude_usd` (4 decimals).
  `line` is a one-line text starting with `"[qwen task]"` giving title, outcome, Qwen calls, Qwen minutes, Qwen
  tokens, Claude tokens and $, estimated saving $, net $, and the cumulative net $ and number of tasks over
  `TASKS_FILE`.
- `read_jsonl(path) -> list[dict]`: lines of a JSON-lines file, skipping invalid lines; [] if missing.
- `summary(tasks, calls) -> dict`: `{"tasks": n, "outcomes": {outcome: count}, "qwen_calls": total calls in
  calls, "legacy_calls": calls without "task", "qwen_minutes": total minutes of all calls,
  "qwen_tokens": .., "claude_usd": sum over tasks, "est_saved_usd": sum over ALL calls,
  "net_usd": sum of net_usd over tasks}`.
- `write_html(tasks, calls, path=None) -> Path`: self-contained interactive plotly page (`include_plotlyjs="cdn"`),
  French titles, `template="plotly_white"`. Panels (make_subplots):
  1. cumulative number of tasks and of Qwen calls against time;
  2. per task (x = title, short): Qwen minutes (bar) and Claude tokens split input / output / cache read /
     cache write (stacked bars, secondary axis or separate row: your choice, keep it readable);
  3. cumulative $ against time: estimated saving (all calls), Claude cost (tasks), net (tasks);
  4. number of tasks per outcome;
  then a `go.Table` row listing every task (date, title, outcome, Qwen calls, Qwen min, Claude tokens, Claude $,
  estimated $, net $). Must work with zero tasks (only legacy calls) and with zero calls.
- `main(argv=None)`: argparse CLI with sub-commands
  `start TITLE [--at ISO]`, `end --outcome X [--note TEXT] [--at ISO]`, `status` (prints the open task or
  "no open task"), `report [--no-html]` (prints the summary in 3-6 lines, writes the HTML unless --no-html and
  prints its path). Print with `sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")` in main.

Keep the file under ~300 lines. When the tests pass, stop and write a short report.

{"path":"qwen_task.py","content":""""
Long-term statistics of the tasks delegated to the local Qwen (ask_local.py / qwen_agent.py).

A *task* is one piece of work delegated to Qwen, from Claude's point of view. It groups:
- the Qwen calls made while the task was open (each call is logged by qwen_savings.log_event
  into CALLS_FILE with the task id in a "task" key; calls without a "task" key are legacy);
- what Claude itself spent on the task (writing the prompt, reviewing, fixing), measured from
  the Claude Code transcript (JSON lines; assistant lines carry "usage", one message = one
  message.id) between the task start and end.

Money (USD, Claude Opus 5.5 API prices, $ per million tokens):
    cost = (input*4 + output*20 + cache_read*0.4 + cache_write_5m*5 + cache_write_1h*8) / 1e6
    est_saved per call = (saved_in*4 + saved_out*20) / 1e6          (same estimate as qwen_savings)
    net_usd per task   = est_saved_usd (of its calls) - claude_usd

Usage:
    python qwen_task.py start "write the parser"          open a task (records the transcript)
    python qwen_task.py end --outcome fixed --note "..."  close it, print the one-line report
    python qwen_task.py status                            show the open task
    python qwen_task.py report [--no-html]                summary + interactive HTML page
"""
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

OUTCOMES = ("ok", "fixed", "failed", "abandoned")
# $ per million tokens, Claude Opus 5.5 API (claude-api skill)
PRICES = {"input": 4.0, "output": 20.0, "cache_read": 0.4, "cache_write_5m": 5.0, "cache_write_1h": 8.0}

ZERO_USAGE = {"turns": 0, "input": 0, "output": 0, "cache_read": 0,
              "cache_write_5m": 0, "cache_write_1h": 0, "tokens": 0, "usd": 0.0}


# --- paths (read from the environment at CALL time so tests can redirect them) ---
def stats_dir() -> Path:
    """Directory of the stats files (env QWEN_STATS_DIR)."""
    return Path(os.environ.get("QWEN_STATS_DIR", "C:/Users/SIM/Desktop/Code-Adri/Qwen-Benchmark/stats"))


def calls_file() -> Path:
    """Per-call log written by qwen_savings.log_event."""
    return stats_dir() / "qwen_usage.jsonl"


def tasks_file() -> Path:
    """One JSON line per closed task."""
    return stats_dir() / "tasks.jsonl"


def current_file() -> Path:
    """File of the task currently open."""
    return stats_dir() / "current_task.json"


def html_file() -> Path:
    """Self-contained plotly page of the long-term statistics."""
    return stats_dir() / "qwen_stats.html"


def transcripts_dir() -> Path:
    """Claude Code transcripts (env CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR)."""
    return Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR", "~/.claude/projects")).expanduser()


# --- helpers ---
def _parse_time(value) -> dt.datetime:
    """ISO string (with Z / offset, or naive = UTC) or None (now) -> timezone-aware UTC datetime."""
    if value is None:
        return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime):
        return value if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
    s = str(value).strip()
    if s.endswith("Z"):
        s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
    d = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
    if d.tzinfo is None:
        d = d.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
    return d.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)


def _iso(d: dt.datetime) -> str:
    """Aware datetime -> UTC ISO string ending in Z."""
    return d.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _cost(usage: dict) -> float:
    """USD of one usage dict at PRICES."""
    return sum(usage[k] * p for k, p in PRICES.items()) / 1e6


def _call_saved(c: dict) -> float:
    """Estimated saving of one call line (same formula as qwen_savings)."""
    return (c.get("saved_in", 0) * PRICES["input"] + c.get("saved_out", 0) * PRICES["output"]) / 1e6


def read_jsonl(path) -> list:
    """Lines of a JSON-lines file as dicts, skipping invalid lines; [] if the file is missing."""
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        return []
    out = []
    for line in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        try:
            out.append(json.loads(line))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
    return out


# --- Claude's real usage, from the transcript ---
def newest_transcript(root=None):
    """Newest (mtime) *.jsonl in the subdirectories of root (pattern root/*/*.jsonl); None if none."""
    root = Path(root) if root else transcripts_dir()
    files = [p for p in root.glob("*/*.jsonl") if p.is_file()]
    return max(files, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime) if files else None


def claude_usage(transcript, start, end) -> dict:
    """Sum of the assistant usages of [start, end] (aware UTC) in one transcript.

    One message (same message.id on several lines) is counted once; lines of other types,
    without usage, or not valid JSON are skipped. transcript=None or missing -> all zeros.
    """
    u = dict(ZERO_USAGE)
    p = Path(transcript) if transcript else None
    if p is None or not p.exists():
        return u
    seen = set()
    for line in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        try:
            obj = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if obj.get("type") != "assistant":
            continue
        msg = obj.get("message") or {}
        usage = msg.get("usage")
        if not usage or msg.get("id") in seen:
            continue
        try:
            ts = _parse_time(obj["timestamp"])
        except (KeyError, ValueError):
            continue
        if not (start <= ts <= end):
            continue
        seen.add(msg["id"])
        cc = usage.get("cache_creation") if isinstance(usage.get("cache_creation"), dict) else None
        if cc is not None:
            w5, w1 = cc.get("ephemeral_5m_input_tokens", 0), cc.get("ephemeral_1h_input_tokens", 0)
        else:
            w5, w1 = 0, usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens", 0)
        vals = {"input": usage.get("input_tokens", 0), "output": usage.get("output_tokens", 0),
                "cache_read": usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens", 0),
                "cache_write_5m": w5, "cache_write_1h": w1}
        u["turns"] += 1
        for k, v in vals.items():
            u[k] += v
    u["tokens"] = sum(v for k, v in u.items() if k not in ("turns", "usd", "tokens"))
    u["usd"] = _cost(u)
    return u


# --- task lifecycle ---
def current_task():
    """Content of CURRENT_FILE (the open task), or None."""
    try:
        return json.loads(current_file().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None


def start(title, at=None, transcript=None) -> dict:
    """Open a task (id = start time in UTC), record the transcript to measure Claude on."""
    if current_task() is not None:
        raise RuntimeError("a task is already open")
    t = _parse_time(at)
    task = {"id": t.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"), "title": title, "start": _iso(t),
            "transcript": str(transcript or newest_transcript()) or None}
    stats_dir().mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    current_file().write_text(json.dumps(task, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    return task


def end(outcome, note="", at=None) -> tuple:
    """Close the open task: aggregate its calls and Claude's usage; return (record, one-line report)."""
    if outcome not in OUTCOMES:
        raise ValueError(f"outcome must be one of {OUTCOMES}, got {outcome!r}")
    task = current_task()
    if task is None:
        raise RuntimeError("no task is open")
    end_t = _parse_time(at)
    start_t = _parse_time(task["start"])
    calls = [c for c in read_jsonl(calls_file()) if c.get("task") == task["id"]]
    usage = claude_usage(task.get("transcript"), start_t, end_t)
    est = sum(_call_saved(c) for c in calls)
    record = {
        "id": task["id"], "title": task["title"], "start": task["start"], "end": _iso(end_t),
        "minutes": round((end_t - start_t).total_seconds() / 60.0, 1),
        "outcome": outcome, "note": str(note)[:200],
        "qwen_calls": len(calls), "qwen_minutes": round(sum(c.get("minutes", 0) for c in calls), 2),
        "qwen_tokens": sum(c.get("qwen_in", 0) + c.get("qwen_out", 0) for c in calls),
        "est_saved_tokens": sum(c.get("saved_in", 0) + c.get("saved_out", 0) for c in calls),
        "est_saved_usd": round(est, 4),
        "claude_turns": usage["turns"], "claude_tokens": usage["tokens"], "claude_usd": round(usage["usd"], 4),
        "claude_detail": {k: usage[k] for k in
                          ("input", "output", "cache_read", "cache_write_5m", "cache_write_1h")},
        "net_usd": round(est - usage["usd"], 4),
    }
    line = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False)
    stats_dir().mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(tasks_file(), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")
    current_file().unlink(missing_ok=True)
    all_tasks = read_jsonl(tasks_file())
    cum = round(sum(t.get("net_usd", 0) for t in all_tasks), 4)
    return record, (f"[qwen task] {record['title']} ({outcome}): {record['qwen_calls']} Qwen call(s), "
                    f"{record['qwen_minutes']} min, {record['qwen_tokens']:,} tokens; "
                    f"Claude {record['claude_tokens']:,} tokens, ${record['claude_usd']:.4f}; "
                    f"est. saving ${record['est_saved_usd']:.4f}, net ${record['net_usd']:+.4f} | "
                    f"cumulative: {len(all_tasks)} task(s), net ${cum:+.4f}")


def summary(tasks, calls) -> dict:
    """Aggregate numbers over closed tasks and all calls (including legacy ones)."""
    outcomes = {}
    for t in tasks:
        outcomes[t.get("outcome", "?")] = outcomes.get(t.get("outcome", "?"), 0) + 1
    return {"tasks": len(tasks), "outcomes": outcomes,
            "qwen_calls": len(calls), "legacy_calls": sum("task" not in c for c in calls),
            "qwen_minutes": round(sum(c.get("minutes", 0) for c in calls), 2),
            "qwen_tokens": sum(c.get("qwen_in", 0) + c.get("qwen_out", 0) for c in calls),
            "claude_usd": round(sum(t.get("claude_usd", 0) for t in tasks), 4),
            "est_saved_usd": round(sum(_call_saved(c) for c in calls), 4),
            "net_usd": round(sum(t.get("net_usd", 0) for t in tasks), 4)}


# --- HTML report ---
def write_html(tasks, calls, path=None) -> Path:
    """Self-contained interactive plotly page (French) of the long-term statistics."""
    import plotly.graph_objects as go
    from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

    tasks = sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: t.get("start", ""))
    calls = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: c.get("time", ""))
    fig = make_subplots(rows=5, cols=1, vertical_spacing=0.07,
                        row_heights=[0.18, 0.22, 0.18, 0.14, 0.28],
                        subplot_titles=("Tâches et appels Qwen (cumulatif)", "Par tâche : minutes Qwen / tokens Claude",
                                        "Évolution en $ (cumulatif)", "Tâches par résultat", "Détail des tâches"))
    # 1. cumulative counts over time
    times, n_tasks, n_calls = [], 0, 0
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(tasks) or j < len(calls):
        t_t = tasks[i]["start"] if i < len(tasks) else None
        c_t = calls[j].get("time") if j < len(calls) else None
        now = min((x for x in (t_t, c_t) if x), default=None)
        while i < len(tasks) and tasks[i]["start"] == now:
            n_tasks += 1; i += 1
        while j < len(calls) and calls[j].get("time") == now:
            n_calls += 1; j += 1
        if now is not None:
            times.append(now); times2 = times  # keep one x list
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[now], y=[n_tasks], mode="markers", name="tâches (cumul)"), row=1, col=1)
    fig.select_traces(":named tâches (cumul)").update(x=times)
    if calls:
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[c.get("time") for c in calls],
                                 y=list(range(1, len(calls) + 1)), mode="markers", name="appels Qwen (cumul)"),
                      row=1, col=1)
    # 2. per task: Qwen minutes bar + Claude tokens stacked
    titles = [t["title"][:18] for t in tasks]
    if tasks:
        fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=titles, y=[t.get("qwen_minutes", 0) for t in tasks],
                             name="minutes Qwen", marker_color="#2a6fdb"), row=2, col=1)
        for key, label in (("input", "input"), ("output", "output"), ("cache_read", "cache lecture"),
                           ("cache_write_5m", "cache écriture 5m"), ("cache_write_1h", "cache écriture 1h")):
            fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=titles, y=[(t.get("claude_detail") or {}).get(key, 0) for t in tasks],
                                 name=label, marker_color="rgba(0,0,0,0.15)", yaxis="y3"), row=2, col=1)
        fig.add_yaxis({"title_text": "tokens Claude", "overlaying": "y", "side": "right"}, row=2, col=1)
    # 3. cumulative $ over time
    if tasks or calls:
        t_pts = [(t["start"], round(sum(x.get("est_saved_usd", 0) for x in tasks[:k + 1]), 4),
                  round(sum(x.get("claude_usd", 0) for x in tasks[:k + 1]), 4)) for k, t in enumerate(tasks)]
        c_saved = 0.0
        c_pts = []
        for c in calls:
            c_saved += _call_saved(c)
            c_pts.append((c.get("time"), round(c_saved, 4)))
        all_pts = sorted(t_pts + c_pts, key=lambda p: p[0])
        if t_pts:
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[p[0] for p in t_pts], y=[p[1] for p in t_pts], mode="lines+markers",
                                     name="économie estimée (tâches)"), row=3, col=1)
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[p[0] for p in t_pts], y=[p[2] for p in t_pts], mode="lines+markers",
                                     name="coût Claude (tâches)"), row=3, col=1)
            net = [round(a - b, 4) for a, b in zip((p[1] for p in t_pts), (p[2] for p in t_pts))]
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[p[0] for p in t_pts], y=net, mode="lines+markers", name="net (tâches)"),
                          row=3, col=1)
        if c_pts:
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[p[0] for p in all_pts],
                                     y=[round(c_saved, 4) for _ in range(len(all_pts))][:0] or
                                     [p[1] for p in c_pts], mode="lines", name="économie estimée (tous appels)"),
                          row=3, col=1)
    # 4. tasks per outcome
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=[o for o in OUTCOMES], y=[sum(1 for t in tasks if t.get("outcome") == o) for o in OUTCOMES],
                         name="tâches", marker_color=["#2a9d8f", "#e9c46a", "#e76f51", "#8d99ae"]), row=4, col=1)
    # 5. table of every task
    fig.add_trace(go.Table(
        header=dict(values=["date", "titre", "résultat", "appels Qwen", "min", "tokens Claude", "Claude $",
                            "estimé $", "net $"], fill_color="#f0f4fa"),
        cells=dict(values=[[t["start"][:10], t["title"], t.get("outcome", ""), t.get("qwen_calls", 0),
                            t.get("qwen_minutes", 0), t.get("claude_tokens", 0),
                            round(t.get("claude_usd", 0), 4), round(t.get("est_saved_usd", 0), 4),

def main(argv=None):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Long-term statistics of the tasks delegated to Qwen.")
